description.value: The Patricia Hotel is a budget hotel situated on East Hastings Street in Vancouver's Downtown Eastside, a neighbourhood with a long history and proximity to the city's downtown core. Touring cyclists arriving in Vancouver will find it within reasonable reach of the waterfront seawall cycling routes and urban amenities. It offers a no-frills urban base in one of the city's most storied districts.
